about_the_game:
Team up with three crewmates in Golden Tides, a pirate-themed adventure MOBA where 20–25 minute matches take you across land and sea in intense PvP battles. Choose your hero, lock in your comp, and control the flow of the game. Skirmish on jungle islands, ambush enemies in ancient temples, or sink their ship in a blaze of cannon fire. Whether you're scaling for late or snowballing early, every match demands smart rotations, clean mechanics, and clutch decision-making. You win, or you sink.


    Experience the deep, skill-based gameplay you’d expect from top-tier MOBAs. Whether you’re setting up the perfect engage or punishing a greedy overextend, every victory comes down to a mix of sharp execution and smart strategy.


    Engage in ability-based ship combat where timing, positioning, and teamwork shape every outcome. Every cannon volley, mortar blast, and harpoon strike is a skillshot, turning sea battles into tactical, high-stakes encounters just as intense as any fight on land.


    Whether you're a brawler, a strategist, or a coward, Golden Tides lets you choose your path. Farm PvE to power up, or hunt enemy crews for high-risk, high-reward dominance. However you play, every match is different.


    Each match unfolds in a massive open world with dynamic events, taking the endless replayability of MOBAs to ludicrous levels. And with constant updates, special events, and even more game modes on the horizon, there’s always something new to discover in Golden Tides.

With an ever-growing roster of playable pirates, from the sea elf General Almandee-Breeze who commands the tides themselves, to the ruthless Captain Ashar Sharp and the frost-wielding mage Helios, you’re sure to find a hero that fits your playstyle. Whether you prefer brawlers, control mages, ranged casters, or frontline tanks, every pirate brings their own personality, backstory, and unique abilities to the fight.

Whether you're a strategic mastermind, a fearless brawler, or something in between, Golden Tides is designed to be played your way. Pick your fights carefully, or avoid them altogether. Farm PvE mobs to power up at your own pace, or go full aggression and hunt down enemy crews for high-risk, high-reward dominance. Every match offers multiple paths to victory, so play smart, play bold, or play dirty. The sea doesn’t judge, but it does remember.

Golden Tides is built by Psychedelic Games, a global crew with deep roots in MOBAs, competitive gaming, and top-tier storytelling. Our team includes veterans behind some of the biggest games in the world, and now we’re channeling that experience into something bold, fresh, and unforgettable.

name: Golden Tides

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 / AMD Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 23 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit (latest update) or Windows® 11 64 Bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4790 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1660 6GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 23 GB available space

short_description: Golden Tides is a pirate-themed adventure MOBA where you and three crewmates fight intense PvP battles across land and sea in 20–25 minute matches to claim victory. Engage in skill-based combat, thrilling ship battles, and experience a unique adventure every time you set sail.
